edges.reason: msg.sender is written into owner by the Owned constructor.
Constructor assigns the caller address to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before staging newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token with a msg.sender comparison.
transferOwnership accepts _newOwner as the candidate owner parameter.
_newOwner is stored into the newOwner state variable without validation.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with the pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner back to address(0).
Constructor initializes the token symbol.
Constructor initializes the token name.
Constructor initializes decimals to 18.
Constructor sets the total supply.
Constructor credits the entire supply to a hard-coded address in balances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as a burn adjustment.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)].
_totalSupply is the left operand of the unchecked subtraction.
balances[address(0)] is the right operand and can force underflow.
balanceOf takes tokenOwner as its query parameter.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns the balance through its named local variable.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transfer consumes the 'to' parameter.
transfer consumes the tokens parameter.
tokens is the subtrahend passed to safeSub.
'to' provides the key credited via safeAdd.
approve keys the allowance mapping with msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve consumes the spender parameter.
approve consumes the tokens parameter.
spender indexes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key for allowances.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeSub on balance and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom consumes the 'from' parameter.
transferFrom consumes the 'to' parameter.
transferFrom consumes the tokens parameter.
'from' indexes the balance and allowance entries passed to safeSub.
tokens is subtracted from balance and allowance.
tokens is added to the recipient balance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
allowance consumes tokenOwner.
allowance consumes spender.
tokenOwner is the outer key of the allowed mapping lookup.
allowance returns via its named local variable.
approveAndCall keys the allowance with msg.sender and forwards it to the callee.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall consumes the spender parameter.
approveAndCall consumes the tokens parameter.
approveAndCall forwards the arbitrary data parameter to the callee.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on a caller-supplied contract address.
The spender parameter directly determines the external callee address.
A malicious spender can re-enter the token contract from receiveApproval while allowance state was just written.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external transfer call on a caller-supplied token contract.
tokenAddress parameter determines the external callee address.
A malicious token contract can re-enter the owner contract during the external transfer.
safeAdd performs the unchecked addition a + b before its require.
safeSub performs the subtraction a - b after a bounds require.
safeMul performs the multiplication a * b before its consistency check.
safeAdd declares parameter a.
safeAdd declares parameter b.
Parameter a is the left operand of the addition.
Parameter b is the right operand of the addition.
The addition result is assigned to local c and returned.
safeSub declares parameter a.
safeSub declares parameter b.
Parameter a is the minuend of the subtraction.
Parameter b is the subtrahend and is bounds-checked.
The subtraction result is assigned to local c and returned.
safeMul declares parameter a.
safeMul declares parameter b.
Parameter a is a factor of the multiplication.
Parameter b is a factor of the multiplication.
The multiplication result is assigned to local c and returned.
safeDiv declares parameter a.
safeDiv declares parameter b.
Dividend a flows into the division result stored in local c.
Divisor b flows into the division result stored in local c.
